product_metadata.title: Foamily Throw Pillows Insert - (Pack of 4) Pillow 12" x 12" Inches for Bed and Couch - 100% Machine Washable Cotton Pillow - Indoor Decorative Throw Pillows for Couch & Bed
features: COTTON PILLOWS - Our Cotton Blend pillow cover and filling provide a soft and delicate experience. The soft shell will always look FULL and PLUMP, providing long-term durability.
MACHINE WASHABLE - Foamily's decorative pillow inserts for couch or bed are machine washable. Toss them in the washer to get fast and easy clean decorative pillows.
FORM PACKAGING - The item comes compressed in a rectangular package showing one large or round pillow. Open carefully and allow inserts to recover inch by inch.
INDOOR USE - Do not use the euro pillows for outdoor use - only in a home or office cushion - indoor use only—perfect size for the bed, couch, office, hotel, and dorm.
DIMENSIONS: Each pillow measures 12 x 12 inches. Order one size up for an extra overstuffed look. It'll make decor fabric big bulk with euro/european look. Note: not for toddler use.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash with cold water and line dry. For best results use mild detergent and avoid the use of fabric softener and dryer sheets.
